actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description:
The goblin makes two attacks, using Scim-
itar or Shortbow in any combination.

actions.name: Scimitar
actions.description:
Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. Hit: 5 (1d6
+ 2) Slashing damage, plus 2 (1d4) Slashing damage if the attack roll had Advantage.

actions.name: Shortbow
actions.description:
Ranged Attack Roll: +4, range 80/320 ft. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) Piercing damage, plus 2 (1d4) Piercing
damage if the attack roll had Advantage.

bonus_actions.name: Nimble Escape
bonus_actions.description:
The goblin takes the Disengage or
Hide action.

reactions.name: Redirect Attack
reactions.description: Trigger: A creature the goblin can see

reactions.name: makes an attack roll against it
reactions.description: Response: The goblin chooses a Small or Medium ally within 5 feet of itself. The goblin and that ally swap places, and the ally becomes the target of the attack instead.
